missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Find all products with stock count 0 in the past 6 months, across all locations.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Identify products with inconsistent size options across different styles, and calculate the average unit cost for each size group.

missions.name: Supplier Delays
missions.query: Detect suppliers with a lead time greater than 30 days, and calculate the on-time delivery rate for each supplier.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Find all products with stock count below the reorder point in the past quarter, and calculate the total units sold for each product in the same period.

missions.name: Unit Cost Variance
missions.query: Identify products with a unit cost variance greater than 20% between the current and previous restocking, and calculate the total units sold for each product in the same period.

missions.name: Price Adjustment
missions.query: Detect products with a retail price adjustment greater than 10% in the past 3 months, and calculate the total units sold for each product in the same period.

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Rate
missions.query: Calculate the average on-time delivery rate for each supplier, and identify suppliers with a rate below 80%.

missions.name: Stock Count Consistency
missions.query: Identify products with inconsistent stock counts across different locations, and calculate the average stock count for each product across all locations.

missions.name: Security Domain Scan
missions.query: Show users with risk_level HIGH and account_status ACTIVE

missions.name: Compliance Domain Scan
missions.query: Show recent compliance violations or audit findings

missions.name: Dead Stock Alert
missions.query: Identify products with a stock count of 0 at any location, and have not been restocked in the past 12 months.

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Find products with a size distribution that deviates from the average size distribution by more than 20% across all styles.

missions.name: Supplier Delays
missions.query: Detect suppliers with a lead time greater than 30 days, and have a reorder point breach in the past quarter for more than 10% of their products.

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Identify products with a stock count below the reorder point for more than 50% of the past quarter, and have not been restocked in the past 3 months.

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Trends
missions.query: Find sales events with a units sold variance greater than 20% between the current channel and the average channel sales for the same product in the past quarter.

missions.name: Supplier Country-Specific Compliance
missions.query: Detect suppliers from countries with a high risk of non-compliance, and have a lead time greater than 30 days for more than 10% of their products.

missions.name: Inventory Imbalance
missions.query: Identify products with a stock count imbalance (i.e., stock count at one location is more than 20% different from the average stock count for the same product across all locations) in the past quarter.

missions.name: Retail Price Adjustments
missions.query: Find products with a retail price adjustment greater than 10% in the past 6 months, and have a stock count below the reorder point for more than 50% of the past quarter.

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery
missions.query: Detect suppliers with an on-time delivery rate below 80% in the past quarter, and have a lead time greater than 30 days for more than 10% of their products.

missions.name: Product Categorization
missions.query: Find products with a category that deviates from the average category distribution by more than 20% across all styles, and have a stock count below the reorder point for more than 50% of the past quarter.

missions.name: Operations Domain Scan
missions.query: Show system performance metrics and operational alerts
